title: Daliddo
text: 3. Daliddo daliddo ti bhante vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho bhante Daliddo ti vuccatī ti || || 4. Sattannaṃ kho bhikkhu bojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā Daliddo ti vuccati || Katamesam sattannaṃ || || Satisambojjhaṅgassa || la-pe || || Upekhādambojjhāṅgassa || || 5. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhu sattannam bojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā Daliddo ti vuccatī ti || ||
